answers.notes: Human Review：v284 视觉上位于 native thumb terminal tip；48-vertex candidate 整体对应真实 thumb distal-cap 区域，未见明显侵入中段/近端，也未见明显大片 distal-cap 遗漏。由于当前 min-corner face expansion 使 28/48 个候选顶点自身 geodesic 超过 9 mm，最大 15.894139 mm，当前 33-face 外边界尚不足以直接冻结为最终 membership authority。批准候选的 branch / anatomical region identity，但要求继续进行 boundary-only review 后再冻结最终 cap membership。

circumferential_completeness.interpretation: Projected boundary angular coverage about engineering IP-to-tip centerline; not uniform shaft rings or anatomical proof

bulb_coverage.definition: Depth <= 2*local median edge + 0.5 mm; normal axial component >=0.35; normal variation >=0.07 rad/mm. Proxy only.

proximal_shaft_intrusion.definition: Depth > global transition lower knee 9.5 mm AND normal axial component <0.15 AND normal variation <0.08 rad/mm
proximal_shaft_intrusion.scope: Local distal-shaft continuation relative to rounded tip; not middle/proximal thumb region identity contradiction

thumb_nail_coverage.nail_compatibility_scope: Native mask relationship only; final anatomical cap boundary remains unresolved
thumb_nail_coverage.reason: Cap may intersect the terminal nail edge; approved proximal nail extends onto the distal shaft and need not be in terminal cap. No nail authority change.

curvature_method: Median one-edge normal angle divided by edge length; supplementary least-squares quadratic fit of the native two-ring, with fit RMS and rank. Proxies depend on quad triangulation and mesh resolution.
